reviewItem.question: Does "Allow crossplane to merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs by @n3wscott in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6685" mean a change to protocol-behavior:crossplane|name=merge-existing-mrds (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 can now merge existing MRDs (managed resource definitions) with the MRDs a provider package supplies.
